The '''Rimsoo Seven cantina'''<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|323|Mohris}}</ref> was the [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] for the [[Republic Mobile Surgical Unit 7]] on [[Drongar/Legends|Drongar]]. It was managed by the [[Ortolan/Legends|Ortolan]], [[Baloob]] and [[Mohris]] was the head [[Bartender/Legends|bartender]].
